title: Composition of arbitrary tensor-pulled pairings
statement: Let X,Y,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], k:Z→Y, l:Y→X and t:Z→X with k followed by l = t. Let M,N be O_X-modules and g:M tensor N→O_X any pairing. Use tensor pullback P [def-pc-module-pullback], tensor comparison δ and unit comparison u [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map], and the transported composition isomorphism c [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons]. Then δ_k inverse followed by P_k(δ_l inverse followed by P_l(g) and u_l) and u_k equals (c_M followed by the equality comparison, tensor c_N followed by the equality comparison), then δ_t inverse, P_t(g), and u_t. The exact formula is lean.statement. No square, coefficient maps or compatibility hypothesis is present.

source.place: Definition 6.26.1(2), tensor formula; Tag 0096, adjunction identifying the composition comparison. Expanded monoidal-composition calculation used in the original item proof step 1.

proof.text: Eliminate e by substituting t. The two equality comparisons are identities; expand functoriality of the inner pairing.

Apply the proved unit-composition identity. Construct the natural composition comparison by whiskering picardTensorComparison l and k, composing ordinary pullbackComp and the inverse comparison at k followed by l. Its naturality at g moves the argument composition comparison from O_X to M tensor N.

Apply transported tensor-composition compatibility, obtaining exactly the tensor of the two argument comparisons followed by the composite pulled pairing. No other hypotheses or unit-route changes are made.

lean.statement:
theorem picardPairing_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Z ⟶ Y) (l : Y ⟶ X) (t : Z ⟶ X)
    (e : k ≫ l = t) (M N : X.Modules)
    (g : M ⊗ N ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :
    (picardTensorObjIso k ((tensorPullback l).obj M) ((tensorPullback l).obj N)).inv ≫
      (tensorPullback k).map
        ((picardTensorObjIso l M N).inv ≫ (tensorPullback l).map g ≫
          (picardTensorUnitIso l).hom) ≫ (picardTensorUnitIso k).hom =
    (((picardTensorCompIso k l M).hom ≫
        (eqToIso (congrArg (fun s ↦ (tensorPullback s).obj M) e)).hom) ⊗ₘ
      ((picardTensorCompIso k l N).hom ≫
        (eqToIso (congrArg (fun s ↦ (tensorPullback s).obj N) e)).hom)) ≫
      (picardTensorObjIso t M N).inv ≫ (tensorPullback t).map g ≫
        (picardTensorUnitIso t).hom
